name: vue-spotflow-compatibility-tests
description: Compatibility testing suite for Vue Spotflow SDK across different Vue versions

scripts.install:all: npm run install:vue2 && npm run install:vue32 && npm run install:vue33 && npm run install:vue34
scripts.build:all: npm run build:vue2 && npm run build:vue32 && npm run build:vue33 && npm run build:vue34
scripts.test:compatibility: echo 'Running compatibility tests across all Vue versions...' && npm run build:all

author: Spotflow Contributors
